name: airo-doffy-wrm-codex-all125
description: WRM_codex final all-125 episode run to 100k with 10k milestones

command: set -Eeuo pipefail; stage_dir=/tmp/airo_wrm_codex_stage; for attempt in $(seq 1 900); do if [ -f "${stage_dir}/READY" ]; then exec bash "${stage_dir}/run-wrm-codex-gpulab.sh" all125; fi; sleep 2; done; echo 'Timed out waiting for staged WRM_codex inputs' >&2; exit 2
